Title: Azure Monitor for Azure Virtual Machines is now available in additional regions

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for Azure Virtual Machines is now available in Japan East, North Europe, and East US2. 

Monitor for Virtual Machines monitors and analyzes the performance and health of your Windows and Linux virtual machines hosted in Azure, on-premises, or with another cloud provider.

Learn more about Monitor for Virtual Machines >
